items.text: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S3399

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act authorizing the Chemung county/city of Elmira regional civil
service commission to retroactively appoint and set seniority dates of
certain employees of the board of cooperative educational services,
sole supervisory district for Schuyler, Steuben, Chemung, Tioga and
Allegany counties


 PURPOSE :
This bill authorizes the Chemung County/City of Elmira Regional Civil
Service Commission to adjust the appointment and seniority dates of
certain employees of the Board of Cooperative Educational Services,
Sole Supervisory District for Schuyler, Steuben, Chemung, Tioga and
Allegany Counties, who through no fault of their own, were not
properly appointed to their current positions on their actual,
respective employment dates with the former Board of Cooperative
Services, Sole Supervisory District for Steuben and Allegany Counties

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Sections 1-9. Authorizes the Chemung County/City of Elmira Regional
Civil Service Commission to set the appointment and seniority dates of
certain employees of the Board of Cooperative Educational Services,
Sole Supervisory District for Schuyler, Steuben, Chemung, Tioga and
Allegany Counties.

Section 10. Provides the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :
The Schuyler-Chemung-Tioga BOCES and the Steuben-Allegany BOCES were
officially reorganized (merged) by order of the Commissioner of
Education on July 1, 2006. Kevin Mark, Beverly Jones, Linda
McLaughlin, Margaret Wilson, Theresa Wolf, Diana Ayers, Anne Slocum,
Carrie VanSlyke, and Patricia Sperle, through no fault of their own,
were not properly appointed to their current positions on their
actual, respective employment dates with the former Board of
Cooperative Services, Sole Supervisory District for Steuben and
Allegany Counties. This bill would provide the affected employees with
seniority and other rights calculated from their actual date of
employment.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
2008 Session: S.8024/A.11567 - New bill- Passed Senate, No action in
Assembly

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Authorizes to retroactively appoint and set seniority dates of certain employees for Schuyler, Steuben, Chemung, Tioga and Allegany counties.
